name: Piano Chords for Beginners (Play Any Chord)
instructions: Once you know the major chord formula (root, +4 half-steps, +3 half-steps), you can build a major chord starting on any key.
Try building a major chord starting on D, then on G, using the same formula you learned for C.
Notice the shape your hand makes is nearly identical for each chord -- only the starting position moves.
Watch today's video for a simple way to play any major chord.
